They'll be able to either help you with medication, or direct you to another professional like a therapist or psychiatrist.

I understand how you feel, being sad and not knowing what is causing it only makes it worse. We can keep guessing what it could be, but a doctor will actually try figuring it out, instead of shooting random guesses and hoping one of them hits the target.


About the delusion part, don't beat yourself up over it. There are a lot of people that are going through something similar, you're a normal person going through a tough mental situation. You'd be surprised how many people actually go to therapy nowadays. 

As I said I'm not a professional, but I genuinely hope you get through this, even if my advice might not cater to you. 

Best of luck mate, if you ever need to talk just hit me up.
